approach: Stop treating process as one unit. Hook typographic stock in Renode 1.17 M55 at basic-block boundaries (cpu AddHook at stock_base+offset; hook body execs mid6_region_hooks.py and dumps GP, s0-s31, FPSCR, VPR, and state[0x00..0xDF]). result.one_case: v=3.2 i=0.05 T=0 dt=1 count=1 after the same init as mid6_debug
result.first_remaining_divergence: 0x09A8-0x0D4E (before SoC tail). At 0xD4E stock has smeared qNaN 0x7FC00000 across state[0x08..0x44] and state[0xC0/C4], and state[0xCC]=0; C still holds the 0x926/0x9A8 values (finites, signed Inf, and qNaN already present at 0x926).
result.soc_still_wrong: stock=0, C=-0.05 (0xBD4CCCCD) on this case — expected until the 0x9A8-0xD4E region is fixed
fixes_in_this_milestone: 0x718-0x7E0 loop was incomplete in the draft (only wrote state+0xC0 sums; did not column-store the two 4-wide mixes to sp+0x280 and sp+0x240). That left sp+0x240 stale, so the 0x8D4-0x926 add into state+8 produced -Inf/finite instead of stock's values.

After the loop transliteration, 0x7E4 and 0x926 still differed only in NaN sign (C 0xFFC00000 vs stock 0x7FC00000). Switching q_mul/q_add/q_sub from 4x scalar vmul/vadd to MVE ACLE vmulq_f32/vaddq_f32/vsubq_f32 made 0x7E4, 0x926, and 0x9A8 bit-exact on this case.

notes.hooks: Renode hook Python is a per-hook engine; the monitor python namespace is not visible. Each AddHook execs mid6_region_hooks.py then calls fg_region_snap(self, tag). Hook at 0x718 (loop body) fired 4 times; hook at 0x8D4 (dls, not the le target 0x912) fired once. VPR was 0 at every boundary hook. State pointer after prologue is [sp,#0x58]. [sp,#0x5c]=state+8, [sp,#0x70]=sp+0x240, [sp,#0x48]=state+0xC0, fp=sp+0x200.
notes.0x718_semantics: 4 iters: s11=load(sp+0x188)+load(sp+0x178) walking into state+0xC0; vld4 from state+8 (same base every iter) mixed with columns of the 0x200/210/220/230 tiles; first mix column-stored at sp+0x280, second mix at sp+0x240. Does not write state+8. 0x8D4-0x926 vst4 of k*f168 into fp=sp+0x200 once, then 4x vadd of [sp+0x70]=sp+0x240 with that tile into state+8.
notes.vpr: 0 at all hooked boundaries on this case
